title: Soon Becoming Reality? Starship Catch At Starbase! #spacex #starship #elonmusk

author: NASASpaceflight
description:
SpaceX continues preparations for Starship Flight 15 as work wraps up at Pad 2 ahead of potential static fires for Booster 22 and Ship 42, while teams push forward on Pad 1 upgrades including orbital launch mount leg installation and flame trench progress at Starbase.

This week’s update covers Booster 24 receiving its LOx landing tank and aft dome section as production accelerates, Gigabay’s first 420-ton bridge crane going in, Ship 44 getting transfer tubes, and nosecone/TPS work advancing on Ships 45 through 48. Ship 42 is also receiving Raptors again following cryo testing at Massey’s.

NASA has released an updated HLS timeline for the Artemis program covering test article builds, Cabin One, propellant transfer demos, and Cape launches, while SpaceX’s earnings call included new Flight 14 heat shield views and renders of the planned Ship catch on Flight 15.
